lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Unit assessment: equal angles and proportional sides

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Unit assessment. Work alone, show your steps, and check your work before you finish.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC has ∠A = 49° and ∠B = 95°. Triangle DEF has ∠D = 49° and ∠E = 95°. Are the triangles similar, and on what grounds?
choices: Yes, but only if a pair of corresponding sides is also known to be congruent.
No; angle information alone never establishes similarity.
Yes, by SSS similarity.
Yes, by AA similarity: two pairs of congruent angles force the third pair to be congruent as well.

items.prompt: Under a dilation, a segment not through the centre, under a dilation with scale factor k …
choices: is mapped to a parallel segment k times as long
is mapped to a segment of the same length
is mapped to a perpendicular segment k times as long
is mapped to a segment k² times as long

items.prompt: Dilate the point (3, 6) about the origin with scale factor 2. Give the image.
A figure is dilated so that a side of length 12 becomes a side of length 24. What is the scale factor, and what happens to the figure's area?
choices: scale factor 2; the area is multiplied by 2
scale factor 2; the area is multiplied by 4
scale factor 12; the area is multiplied by 4
scale factor 1/2; the area is multiplied by 4

items.prompt: Triangle ABC has ∠A = 65° and ∠B = 58°. Triangle DEF has ∠D = 65° and ∠E = 58°. Are the triangles similar, and on what grounds?
choices: Yes, by AA similarity: two pairs of congruent angles force the third pair to be congruent as well.
Yes, but only if a pair of corresponding sides is also known to be congruent.
No; angle information alone never establishes similarity.
Yes, by SSS similarity.

items.prompt: Under a dilation, a line that passes through the centre of dilation …
choices: is mapped to a parallel line a fixed distance away
is mapped to a perpendicular line
is mapped onto itself
is mapped to a line through the origin with a different slope

items.prompt: Dilate the point (-7, -5) about the origin with scale factor 4. Give the image.
A figure is dilated so that a side of length 20 becomes a side of length 80. What is the scale factor, and what happens to the figure's area?
choices: scale factor 4; the area is multiplied by 4
scale factor 4; the area is multiplied by 16
scale factor 60; the area is multiplied by 16
scale factor 1/4; the area is multiplied by 16

items.prompt: Under a dilation, a line that does not pass through the centre of dilation …
choices: is mapped onto itself
is mapped to a line with slope multiplied by the scale factor
is mapped to a perpendicular line
is mapped to a parallel line

items.prompt: Dilate the point (1, 5) about the origin with scale factor 5. Give the image.
A figure is dilated so that a side of length 24 becomes a side of length 120. What is the scale factor, and what happens to the figure's area?
choices: scale factor 5; the area is multiplied by 5
scale factor 1/5; the area is multiplied by 25
scale factor 96; the area is multiplied by 25
scale factor 5; the area is multiplied by 25
